title: Rethinking Microsoft Licensing: Navigating the Shift from EA to CSP
summary: Discover what Microsoft’s evolving EA strategy means for your business. Join Xerox IT Solutions for a live session on CSP, MCA-E, and smarter licensing decisions.
body_markdown:
## Your Microsoft Agreement May Be Changing. Now What?


Microsoft’s Enterprise Agreement landscape is evolving, and many organizations are being asked to rethink how they buy and manage Microsoft licensing moving forward.


Join Xerox IT Solutions for a fast-paced, 30-minute conversation followed by live Q&A, breaking down what’s changing with EA, how CSP compares to MCA-E, and what organizations should consider when evaluating the right path forward.


### Rethinking Microsoft Licensing: Navigating the Shift from EA to CSP June 11, 2026 at 11:00 AM CST


45-Minute Live Session + Q&A


#### In this session, we'll cover:


-


What Microsoft’s EA changes mean for your business.


-


Key differences between CSP, EA, and MCA-E.


-


How to evaluate the right buying model for your organization.


-


Why more organizations are turning to Xerox IT Solutions as their CSP partner.


#### Speaker:


Ryne M Rossetti Program Director, SaaS Microsoft Cloud & Licensing Specialist ** With more than 15 years of Microsoft licensing and cloud expertise, Ryne helps organizations simplify complex purchasing decisions and align Microsoft investments with business goals. Bring your questions and join the conversation. We look forward to seeing you there.
